mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an ongoing monetary tightening cycle that increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen in the past month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it signals aggressive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and suppresses corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS rising) combined with weak housing demand (HOUST falling) indicates an overheating economy with cooling consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and HOUST falls, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) combined with falling retail sales (RSAFS) indicates an economic imbalance with excess supply and weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO rises and RSAFS falls, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 115) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 115, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST > 1800) signals robust consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1800, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
